description: Survey Department - Amendment to the Service Minute of the Sri Lanka Surveyors'  Services
reasoning: This gazette content pertains to amendments to the Service Minute of the Sri Lanka Surveyors' Service, specifically detailing service conditions, promotion criteria, and performance appraisal procedures for public service officers. It is issued by the Public Service Commission, which is the central body for public service administration, making it a clear example of a Public Service Gazette (Type 8).
